event.description: Reduce interleaved model feed-forward width from 32 to 24
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 5,024 parameters at 99.880000%, a +0.880000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 2 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0006, ff_dim=32 at 5,024 parameters and 99.88% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0001, an optimization failure for ff_dim=44 under the superseded separated-token representation with no official score. Hypothesis: the interleaved geometry retains further nonlinear-width slack, so reducing ff_dim 32->24 is parameterization-preserving compression that removes 512 parameters while leaving attention and representation unchanged. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=28 because a 25% cut establishes a clearer lower-capacity boundary after width 32 still achieved a 99.93% internal checkpoint at step 15,000.
